note: prodcluster campaign (2026-10-05, U-29): self-hosted RKE2 cluster, VictoriaMetrics backend, amd64 nodes, images built from 0472829. A new campaign: no EKS sample or interval applies. benchmark_history_start is set (v2) to the first ten-minute grid instant after all six generators run the challenge-v1 script without restarts; until then it is null and no training is a benchmark training. Same rules as the EKS mask: samples inside an interval are excluded and never interpolated; an interval kept only for the hourly load gates contains no grid sample (endpoints inclusive). v2 (2026-10-05T05:13:25Z): benchmark_history_start = regimes[0].start = 2026-10-05T05:10:00Z, the first ten-minute grid instant after the generators (running since 04:43:54Z, 0 restarts) and the six arms ran on their final templates (collective-spread rollouts finished 04:58Z); at 05:10:00Z every arm read 285.0 req/min destination-observed and 285.0 k6-delivered (1-minute rates). v1's null start meant no exclusion; the 04:42Z cold-start training published no artifact (/models empty). v3 (2026-10-05T06:45:00Z): benchmark_history_start = regimes[0].start = 2026-10-05T06:40:00Z. Defect: with keep-alive connections and no sidecar on the generators, each VU kept the connection opened while its arm had one pod, so the replicas added at ~06:01Z received no requests (06:01-06:27Z: ~7,775 on each old pod, zero on each new pod). The generators were rolled at 06:37:48Z (Recreate) with K6_NO_VU_CONNECTION_REUSE=true (public 38f49de); 06:40:00Z is the first ten-minute grid instant after it: every arm read 790-801 req/min destination-observed and 791 k6-delivered (1-minute rates), both pods of every arm received requests in the preceding minute, the generators had 0 restarts, and the new k6 runs had no failed or dropped requests. Arm totals (the series trained on) were unaffected by the pinning, but history now starts from the final generator template. The first real training stays 2026-10-07T00:00Z (235 points need 39 h 10 min). v4 (2026-10-07T20:35:00Z, D-1083): interval for the generator restart only; history start unchanged. All six generators were restarted together at 20:30:20Z (Recreate; script gained the dense failure counter bench_req_failed and a 30-day schedule; offered load unchanged): old runs' last k6 samples 20:30:24.9-25.4Z, new runs started 20:30:40.7Z and delivered the planned 1,137 rpm from their first full flush (k6 per-flush rates). The interval covers every one-minute rate window that overlaps the gap and contains no ten-minute grid sample; the 20:30:00Z and 20:40:00Z samples are valid. Recorded for the hourly load gates and scoring; the trainer is unaffected. v5 (2026-10-08T13:45:00Z, D-1096): interval for the generator OOM outage 08:01:00-13:42:00Z on 2026-10-08 (all six k6 generators crash-looped at the 384Mi limit after the 08:00Z step; fixed by raising the limit to 1Gi, replacements started 13:38:39-40Z); history start unchanged. Grid samples 08:10-13:40Z are excluded from training and inference; the hybrid trainer's longest contiguous run ends at 08:00Z until the post-outage run is longer.

intervals.reason: controlled restart of all six k6 generators together (D-1083: dense bench_req_failed counter, DAYS 8 -> 30; Recreate; arrival-rate schedule untouched): ~15-20 s without requests per arm between 20:30:25Z and 20:30:41Z; the interval covers the one-minute rate windows overlapping it and contains no grid sample (public 190cc0d manifests)

generator outage (D-1096): with the 30-day schedule every k6 generator idled near its 384Mi memory limit; after the 08:00Z planned step (1,270 -> 2,050 rpm) all six were OOMKilled (first restarts recorded 08:02:00-08:04:00Z) and crash-looped until the limit was raised to 1Gi; the replacements started 13:38:39-13:38:40Z and delivered the planned rate from 13:39Z. Between, the offered load was bursty or absent per arm. Every ten-minute grid sample from 08:10Z to 13:40Z lies inside and is excluded (the 08:00Z sample's one-minute window closed before the first kill; 13:42Z covers the rate window after recovery). The 12Z training of 2026-10-08 used these samples (mask v4 was live).

regimes.generator: k6-load-script-challenge-v1 (deploy/eks-benchmark/workload/challenge-v1, profile.json frozen at 9f38a1a); rate is a pure function of wall-clock time; since 06:37:48Z every generator runs with K6_NO_VU_CONNECTION_REUSE=true (public 38f49de); since 2026-10-07T20:30:40Z every generator also counts failures in bench_req_failed and runs a 30-day schedule (public 190cc0d, D-1083); since 2026-10-08T13:38:40Z every generator runs with a 512Mi memory request and a 1Gi limit (D-1096, public db25b30)
